title: Make shift identity the shared app shell
summary: Turns the compact branded Night concept into one coherent product system across Night, Changes, Breaks, Chat, Actions, Account and administrator surfaces without changing roster logic.
changes: Rebuilds the Night opening as one compact branded hero where Mater Dei, Main Operating Theatres, the account control, the customizable shift logo, shift name, motto, selected night and personalised greeting read as one composition instead of stacked competing rows.

Moves Main Operating Theatres into a compact top-row pill, removes the redundant Your night label, enlarges the shared shift identity and gives the greeting deliberate breathing room while keeping the selected-night date control visible and usable.

Carries the same institutional and team identity into Changes, Breaks and Chat at a deliberately lower visual intensity, while keeping each screen's workflow, break plan or conversation as the dominant task surface and giving Actions, Account and administrator utilities the restrained version of the same surface language.

Preserves roster calculations, staffing rules, First and Second Part semantics, Malta and DST timing, authentication, database writes, offline safety, clinical state colours, accessibility states and guarded mutation paths.
